_note: Sidecar for the integrator. The Compose Desktop parity capture is the FIRST executed cross-renderer fidelity measurement in this project. It exercises the Compose element layer and :core resolution on the JVM. IT IS NOT AN ANDROID DEVICE CAPTURE AND NOT AN iOS CAPTURE: no `ios` or `android` cell of OpenSource/Conformance/library/matrix.json may be flipped from this evidence, in either direction. Every row below proposes a stamp in a SEPARATE `desktop` column that matrix.json does not yet have; adding that column is the integrator's call, and until it exists these rows are evidence only. Nothing here was written into matrix.json or generate_library_matrix.rb by the capture lane.

capture.host: Linux x86_64, JDK 21, Compose Multiplatform 1.10.3, offscreen Skia under Xvfb

notElevated: No component below is claimed VERIFIED. Every proposed value is "review": the capture proves the element composes and lays out on Compose Desktop and records how far its settled boxes sit from the web plane, not that the presentation is correct.
